data.description: Three times per day as a swift action, a demon lord can summon any demon or combination of demons whose total combined CR is 20 or lower. This otherwise works like the summon universal monster rule with a 100%% chance of success, and counts as a 9th-level spell effect.
data.name: Summon Demons
